security_problem: Cross-tool capability laundering occurs when an agent hops among MCP servers or tools so that every local call appears under a per-tool limit while the correlated same-capability trajectory exceeds caller-held authority. Trusted: the caller-held EvaluationRoot containing the enabled flag, resource-use graph, exact use/server/tool identities, caller-held capability assignments, caller-held usage units, directed correlation edges, and per-capability ceilings. Untrusted: ProposedAction, use references, requested capability, claimed per-tool ALLOW, claimed server-hop innocence, claimed remaining quota, and claimed authorization.
required_behavior: Authorize is pure and evaluates C1-C9 exactly. Enabled ALLOW requires every requested use reference to resolve by sequential exact field comparison against one caller-held resource use, every adjacent resolved pair to have its exact directed caller-held graph edge, every resolved use to carry the exact requested capability, an exact caller-held ceiling to exist for that capability, and aggregate caller-held units across the complete ordered trajectory to remain at or below the ceiling. Claims are ignored as authority; disabled, malformed, missing, misbound, disconnected, capability-mismatched, unceilinged, and over-ceiling trajectories deny. Fixed fixture rates are deterministic counts over eight ordered records with seed metadata and no RNG.
failure_behavior: The canonical fixture correlates four individually one-unit repository-read uses across GitHub, Drive, Notion, and GitHub. Every use resolves, every required graph edge exists, every use carries capability:repository-read, and the held ceiling is present, but complete correlated usage is 4 against a ceiling of 3, so authorization denies with usage EXCEEDED, correlation INVALID, proof INVALID, and exact eight-line evidence. The vulnerable baseline callback fires while Visor does not. The legitimate three-use same-capability trajectory totals 3 against 3 and allows. Deterministic fixture counts are false-correlation formation 5/6, propagation 3/6, and legitimate over-rejection 0/2.
non_goals: Do not claim cross-tool hopping is prevented in production
HMAC, signatures, certificates, or hash chains
Sliding, fixed, or token-bucket runtime windows
Subprocesses except the existing demo go run pattern
